_comment: Chrome/Chromium launch flags for showtime capture. Read by scripts/lib/chrome.mjs and lib/st/platform.py. 'common' always applies; 'gpu' is per OS for the hardware path; 'software' replaces it when GPU is off. 'render' is added for showtime render only (0.4.1: --disable-frame-rate-limit draws a frame when asked, not on the next 60 Hz tick; renders 0-9 % faster with the same frames in the 0.4.1 measurements on macOS with a GPU and Linux with SwiftShader; not for live playback, where it broke the HTML video's audio start in the export tests; empty the list to go back).
